headline: Come home to calm.
tagline: Reliable, thoughtful home cleaning for the spaces that matter most.
about: From regular upkeep to a complete seasonal refresh, we focus on the details that make home feel welcoming. Tell us the rooms, your priorities and preferred schedule.
seo_description: Reliable, thoughtful home cleaning for the spaces that matter most.

services.name: Recurring home care
services.description: Flexible weekly, fortnightly and monthly visits that keep your home feeling fresh.

services.name: One-off refresh
services.description: A thorough reset before visitors, after an event or whenever life gets busy.

services.name: Kitchen and bathrooms
services.description: Focused attention for high-use areas, fixtures and touchpoints.

services.name: Moving day support
services.description: Practical cleaning assistance when you are settling in or moving on.

faqs.question: Can I choose my cleaning priorities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share the rooms and tasks you care about most when requesting a quote.

faqs.question: Are supplies included?
faqs.answer: Ask about products and equipment when arranging your service; inclusions depend on your quote.

faqs.question: Can I book an ongoing visit?
faqs.answer: Tell us your preferred frequency and we can discuss an appropriate schedule.

service_areas.name: Local Residential service areas
service_areas.description: Contact us to confirm availability for your suburb or neighbourhood.

blog_posts.title: Residential cleaning preparation
blog_posts.summary: A practical checklist before your appointment.
blog_posts.body: Clear access to the work area, identify priority surfaces and discuss any delicate materials before cleaning begins.
